name: Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd
about: Established in 2004, Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited is a pharmaceutical contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) offering a comprehensive range of pharmaceutical products and services.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] Akums Drugs is a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) manufacturing tablets, capsules, liquid orals, vials, ampoules, blow-filled seals, topical preparations, eye drops, dry powder injections, and gummies.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 48.9% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.3% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 13.1% over last 3 years.
